results.name: Contextual route updates preserve source ID, target, filter and exact focus
Actionable correction lists escape source copy and preserve explicit routes
Search opens exact records beyond programs and excludes out-of-scope records
Global starting points never expose record-detail routes without their IDs
Pending modal save stays open, prevents double submission and closes after completion
Failed asynchronous save keeps user entries and displays the actual failure
A review-before-commit continuation retains its next-step label and stays open
Previewing a proposed change does not mark its unsaved fields as committed
A command opening its next dialog does not have the new dialog closed by old completion
Blank required values fail before invoking the mutation and retain the dialog
Repeated validation keeps unique focus destinations when different fields become invalid
Dirty-dialog dismissal preserves entries until an explicit discard
Keeping a dirty modal leaves source and entries unchanged
Back-style hash navigation preserves dirty entries and follows the target only on discard
Async action failures unlock the same control and do not produce an unhandled rejection
